diagnostic_1_future_p90_discrimination.description: Ability of prospective pre-P90 health scores to separate eventual-P90 qualifiers from never-P90 regimes
diagnostic_1_future_p90_discrimination.interpretation: M2-U prospective strength variables successfully identify future-P90 regimes before P90 occurs, proving P90 is largely a marker of already-observable trend expansion.

diagnostic_2_incremental_value_of_p90_ev.description: Incremental AUC and Brier lift of adding observed P90 state (M2-U -> M3-U)
